instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium close-up shot. Indoors in a bright office during the day, the bearded man in the striped shirt (R1) sits on the left side of the frame, looking down thoughtfully with a neutral expression. To his right, the woman in the beige collared shirt (R2) sits looking down and to the left towards the foreground. An out-of-focus hand holding a thin wooden stick is visible in the lower center foreground, capturing their gaze. Soft, natural light streams from a window in the background, illuminating the scene with neutral colors.
